title: HoMe: Toward Practical Harness Optimization of Memory Systems for AI Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2611.34624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The behavior of memory systems for long-running AI assistants is governed by a harness, which consists of the code, prompts, and configurations for memory construction, maintenance, retrieval, and answer generation. However, optimizing the harness of a memory system remains largely manual, and unrestricted editing alone does not ensure structural improvements. In this paper, we introduce HoMe, an evaluation-driven framework that iteratively evaluates candidate harnesses and derives each new candidate from any previously evaluated harness by editing any part of it. HoMe combines session-level memory versioning with execution traces to identify shared failure mechanisms across cases and localize them to the responsible sessions and harness components. It encourages early structural exploration through candidate gating and reduces evaluation cost through smoke tests, adaptive sampling, and the reuse of constructed memory. We validate HoMe w

translated_title: HoMe：面向AI助手记忆系统的实用控制框架优化
translated_abstract: 长期运行的AI助手记忆系统的行为由一个控制框架支配，该框架由用于记忆构建、维护、检索和答案生成的代码、提示词和配置组成。然而，记忆系统控制框架的优化在很大程度上仍然是手动的，且仅靠不受限制的编辑并不能确保结构上的改进。在本文中，我们提出了HoMe，这是一个由评估驱动的框架，它迭代地评估候选控制框架，并通过编辑任意部分从任何先前评估过的控制框架中派生出新的候选框架。HoMe将会话级记忆版本控制与执行轨迹相结合，以识别跨案例的共同失败机制，并将其定位到相关的会话和控制框架组件。它通过候选门控机制鼓励早期的结构性探索，并通过冒烟测试、自适应采样和已构建记忆的复用来降低评估成本。我们验证了HoMe（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HoMe提出了一个评估驱动的框架，通过迭代评估与编辑候选控制框架，并结合会话级记忆版本控制和执行轨迹分析来定位共享失败机制，从而自动化优化AI助手记忆系统的代码、提示词与配置设计。
en_tdlr: HoMe is an evaluation-driven framework that automatically optimizes memory system harnesses for AI assistants through iterative candidate evaluation, session-level memory versioning, and execution trace analysis to localize shared failure mechanisms.
